a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells is very unlikely, so our agreement would probably leave us both dead. The reserve can make only one of us safe right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you so you aren't misled. If you'd rather operate after that, I'll come back to operate with you so you have a chance to reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can reach 4. I won't take anything more.
